entry.title: micro-interactions in practice
entry.content:
Short post: micro-interactions is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Micro-interactions shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: rethinking micro-interactions
entry.content:
Every few months micro-interactions bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Micro-interactions shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: thinking about micro-interactions
entry.content:
I keep coming back to micro-interactions, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Micro-interactions shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
